$description: Mock backend responses for verifying the 4 portal status-rendering states (spec.md FR-008/FR-009/FR-017) before wiring to the live API. Shapes follow specs/001-expense-policy-engine/contracts/api.yaml (ExpenseClaim / ValidationError schemas).

$status_mapping_used_for_these_mocks.note: Backend only distinguishes auto_approved | pending_review | rejected | needs_information | approved | withdrawn (see api.yaml). The portal-facing 'Requires Manager' vs 'Audit Flagged' split is a UI presentation decision (spec.md Assumptions) — these mocks use a simple heuristic so all 4 badge states can be exercised: a pending_review claim maps to 'Audit Flagged' if it carries a possible_duplicate, late_submission, or uncapped_category violation (integrity/compliance concerns), otherwise it maps to 'Requires Manager' (routine cap/receipt/weekend/threshold checks). Confirm/replace this heuristic when the real mapping is finalized in /speckit-plan.
